title: LoRA-based Adaptation Alone Is Not Enough: Understanding the Limits of Foundation Models for Face Presentation Attack Detection
abstract: arXiv:2608.09633v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Face presentation attack detection (PAD) aims to reliably detect a wide range of presentation attacks. While PAD methods achieve strong performance within individual datasets, their performance degrades under cross-dataset evaluation. Variations in sensors or lighting conditions can reduce the effectiveness of detectors from near-perfect to nearly random. Foundation models (FMs) have emerged as a promising alternative because typical PAD datasets, such as the MCIO benchmarks (MSU-MFSD, CASIA-FASD, Replay-Attack, and OULU-NPU), are small relative to the scale used for web-based pretraining. However, existing PAD systems primarily focus on CLIP-based foundation models, while overlooking other FMs with different architectures and training procedures. translated_abstract: 人脸呈现攻击检测（PAD）旨在可靠地检测各种呈现攻击。尽管PAD方法在单个数据集内表现强劲，但在跨数据集评估时性能会下降。传感器或光照条件的变化可能使检测器的效果从接近完美降至接近随机。基础模型（FMs）已成为一种有前景的替代方案，因为典型的PAD数据集（如MCIO基准测试：MSU-MFSD、CASIA-FASD、Replay-Attack和OULU-NPU）相对于基于网络的预训练规模而言较小。然而，现有的PAD系统主要关注基于CLIP的基础模型，而忽视了具有不同架构和训练过程的其他FM。本研究通过系统评估32个FM来解决这一问题。零样本提示在模型家族和规模上的表现接近随机水平。视觉编码器，当...
tldr: 本研究系统评估了32个基础模型在人脸呈现攻击检测中的表现，发现仅依赖LoRA适配或零样本提示不足以实现有效的跨数据集泛化，揭示了基础模型在此任务中的局限性。
en_tdlr: This study systematically evaluates 32 foundation models for face presentation attack detection, revealing that LoRA-based adaptation or zero-shot prompting alone is insufficient for effective cross-dataset generalization, highlighting the limitations of foundation models in this task.
